## Overview
 
Our product, competitive landscape, and costs are all frequently changing. To keep our pricing aligned with the market and with how customers derive value, we re-evaluate the pricing of our products annually to determine whether changes are needed to our **price levels, packaging, metrics, and more**.
 
## Instructions
 
- **Create one issue per product** you PM for using this template. If you own multiple products, open a separate issue for each.
- **Tag your exec team lead and product team lead** below for visibility.
- For any opportunities identified during the review:
  - If the change is straightforward, **action on it directly**.
  - If the change requires more thought or approval, **open a new RFC** detailing the proposed changes and link it back to this issue.
---
 
## Pricing Review: <Product Name>
 
**PM:** @your-handle
**Exec lead:** @exec-lead-handle
**Product lead:** @product-lead-handle
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Are we still competitive?

**1. Has there been any meaningful competitive pricing changes in the past year in your product area?**
 
>
 
**2. Has one or more competitors gotten more competitive in the past year (large new player entering your segment, improved product, etc.)?**
 
>

**3. Is your product's discounting scheme scaling appropriately with competition and keeping us competitive (but not undercutting too much) on sales deals?**
 
> 

## Do we have the right pricing metric & structure?

**4. Does your current packaging structure still fit the customer segments that are using your product?**
 
>
 
**5. Does your current price metric still fit the way in which customers derive value from your product?**
 
>
 
**6. Have there been any major changes to the cost profile of your product?**
 
>

## Your recommendation
 
**7. Based on your answers, do you think we should make any changes to this product's pricing, packaging, metrics or discounting? (Major changes may require a separate RFC — link it here if applicable.)**
 
>
